title: Allgemeinverfügung zum 1. Mai 2026 – Einschränkungen im Bereich Treptower Park

extraction.summaryEn: Police issued a general order restricting assemblies in the Treptower Park area from 6 a.m. on 1 May 2026 to 6 a.m. on 2 May 2026 to protect the green space and listed garden monument. The order covers the area between the Spree, Bulgarische Straße, Am Treptower Park and the S-Bahn line.
